raw_blocks: Smith Douglas Homes Home Builder in AL, GA, NC, SC, TN & TX

Smith Douglas Homes was founded in 2008 by a core team of new home building professionals, including recognized experts with nearly 50 years of experience. Our team is known for constructing quality homes at affordable prices in the places where you want to live. We strive to provide a superior value to our competitors in a home that feels like it is worth far more. In short, we give you a quality, well-built home for less.
Design Your New Home With Our Interactive Home Shopping Tools

Smith Douglas Homes is widely recognized for constructing quality homes with choices you can afford. Our proven, schedule-driven process reduces wasted time and materials. It results in a well-constructed home, with the features that make it your own, for less than you might expect. Find your new home across Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina, Tennessee or Texas.

The details make a house a home. That's why Smith Douglas Homes offers more choices to make your home feel uniquely your own. Explore our interactive home design tools to visualize everything from homesite maps to exterior colors, floorplan options and interior selection colors. Start personalizing your new home today.

A new home with Smith Douglas may be more affordable than you thought. Explore our new home shopping resource section for interactive tools, articles and videos to help you learn more about financing, estimated monthly payments, and preparing for a down payment toward your new home.
